subject: dsa
title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
summary: Rebuild a binary tree from its preorder and inorder traversals.
problem: Given preorder and inorder traversals of a binary tree, reconstruct the tree. Preorder visits root, then left, then right. Inorder visits left, then root, then right.

example.output: tree with root 3, left 9, right 20 (children 15 and 7)

steps.caption: Rebuild the tree. Preorder gives each subtree's root first, and inorder splits the rest into left and right.
Preorder's next value 9 sits left of 3 in inorder, so it is the left child of 3.
Preorder's next value 20 is the right subtree's root, so it becomes the right child of 3.
Inorder splits 20's part into left 15 and right 7, so attach both under 20.
Tree rebuilt. Root 3, then 9 and 20, with 15 and 7 under 20.
